name: University of Westminster
description: The University of Westminster was the first polytechnic university in England, founded in 1838 to train London staff. Currently, the university serves approximately 19,000 students. There are about 169 students from different nationalities studying in the huge campus. The university, which has developed in this process, now has 183 partners in the business world. The purpose of the university is to provide a continuous-holistic education with broad horizons and opportunities. Thus, all students can realize their true potential and contribute to a richer and happier society. University of Westminster is ranked in the top 700 in QS World University Rankings 2023 and 89th in the UK.
